content: ꞌInapwanao nuwanuwadi be Yesu siloemwawasi
Yesu ꞌina ona getedi ꞌilosalonidi, ga ꞌina tononoyao ꞌieonedi,
ꞌigwae, “Wamwalatonina ꞌasiyata ꞌeluwa be Ataona Sagalina taguinuwe, be ꞌenega ꞌagu tosipupu ꞌida ꞌebwayaegu ꞌagu talauwalao ꞌediya, be kelose ꞌena sida loemwawasigu, Tomota Natuna ꞌaboꞌagu.”
ꞌEnega totaliyao sinabwadi be me Isileli ꞌidi ꞌinapwanao sideli egogonama Kaiyapa ꞌina anuwa sinabwana ꞌenaya, tauna totaliyao ꞌidi ꞌinapwana sinabwana.
ꞌEnega ꞌinapwanao nidi taudimo siloina be ꞌaene kaboega Yesu sida giyai be sida loemwawasi,
ta sigwae, “Geyaꞌabo sagali solanaya Yesu tagiyagiyai, ꞌabona nai tomota sigamwasowaleda be silosaiya ꞌedaya.”
Waine Yesu ꞌieoloina ꞌasa Betani ꞌenaya
Tuta nina Yesu Betani ꞌena ꞌimiyami, Saimoni ꞌina anuwaya. Tauna lowa tolepelo ꞌebweu.

ꞌEnega ꞌebweu waine ma ina bunama ꞌimai, ta bunama nina ꞌana maisa sinabwana, ta botolo boboꞌana wawasae ꞌenaya ꞌisiwena. Yesu ꞌetamo anuwaya ꞌiꞌeꞌai, ta waine nina ꞌimai ga bunama nina Yesu debanaya ꞌisiwena.
Ta Yesu ꞌina tononoyao siꞌitena ga waine silomugiyena, sigwae, “Toꞌase manuna bunama ꞌimudalina?
ꞌIlobwenena be bunama nina ꞌigimwaneye be maisa sinabwana ꞌiꞌewa be ꞌieguyaiye togomabeso ꞌediya.”
Ta Yesu ꞌidi ona nina ꞌimwalatonina ga ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo waine gete walomulomugiyei, manuna ꞌina lema gete ꞌeguya boboꞌana wawasae.
Togomabeso nidi waoneonediya tuta maiboꞌana selabemiya simiyami, ta ꞌaboꞌagu esi nigeya tuta dudulana maꞌemi tamiyami.
Waine gete niꞌatu ꞌieoloigu bwalagu ꞌana saꞌuꞌaliꞌali manuna.
Ta onaꞌaiꞌaila, maꞌetamo teteligu ꞌana loguguya tomota sinoonoi baleꞌu maiboꞌana ꞌenaya, ta waine gete ꞌina guinuwa ꞌeguya tetelina sida emwasali wate.”
Yudasa ꞌitagwala be Yesu ꞌida telesipupuye
Ta Yesu ꞌina tonono ꞌebweu ꞌana esana Yudasa Isikaliota ꞌitauya totaliyao sinabwadi ꞌediya,
ga ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “ꞌEisa maisa waꞌebwaꞌegu ꞌabo Yesu ꞌemiya yatelesipupuye?” ꞌEnega mani siliba ꞌana yau teti siꞌebwaꞌena.
ꞌEnega Yudasa tuta boboꞌana ꞌiyamwena be ꞌaene Yesu ꞌediya ꞌida telesipupuye be sigiyai.
Ataona masulina siguinuwena

Ataona masulina beledi daisina, nigeya gieseseinamo sieꞌani. Ga Ataona masulina ꞌana ꞌasiyata nugana ꞌena Yesu ꞌina tononoyao ꞌaidi ꞌenaya simai ga sigwae, “ꞌInapwana, mane ꞌena nuwanuwayo be Ataona masulina manuyo ꞌagibubu?”

ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌiona, “Watauya Yelusalema be ꞌigu sida ꞌebweu tai ꞌena wasimane, wagwae, ‘ꞌIma toeꞌita ꞌina ona gete nadigega ꞌaene “ꞌIgu tuta niꞌatu ꞌiapwesama ta nuwanuwagu be ꞌimu anuwaya Ataona masulina ma igu tononoyao ꞌaꞌaꞌani.” ’ ”
Ga tonono nidi Yesu ꞌina ona nina siematamatanena ga tai nina ꞌina anuwaya Ataona masulina sigibubuna.
ꞌEnega ꞌasuinuwanuwaya Yesu ma ina tononoyao site tuwelo nidi silugu ga masula nina siꞌenina.
Ta ꞌidi ꞌeꞌai solanaya Yesu ꞌigwae, “Gosegwao, yaona ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌaene ꞌebweu ꞌemiyega ꞌiabe ꞌitelesipupuyegu.”
Ta Yesu ꞌina ona gete manuna sinuwamwau ꞌaiꞌaila, ga ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna Yesu ꞌena ꞌienaida, ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, yaita tauna? Nai ꞌaboꞌagu?”
Ta Yesu ꞌieonedi, “Tai nina tauna maꞌiyagu gaeba ꞌebweuna ꞌenega ꞌaꞌeꞌai, tauna ꞌiabe ꞌitelesipupuyegu.
ꞌAboꞌagu Tomota Natuna maꞌetamo yatatauya ꞌeda nina lowa Buki Tabu ꞌena ꞌigimisimanena, ta esi ꞌagu tosipupu nina nuwaꞌoleꞌolena saꞌi, ta boboꞌana ꞌabo lowa sinana geyaꞌabo ꞌida enaenatune.”
ꞌEnega ꞌana totelesipupu Yudasa ꞌieonena, “ꞌInapwana, to tai tauna? Nai ꞌaboꞌagu?” Ga Yesu ꞌigwae, “Niꞌatu ꞌuona saba.”
ꞌInapwana ꞌina ꞌeꞌai
ꞌEtamo siꞌeꞌai ta Yesu masula ꞌiꞌewena ga manuna ꞌiona oboboma ta ꞌigitomwena ga ꞌina tononoyao ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi, ꞌigwae, “Gete oogu waꞌewa be waꞌaꞌani.”
Ta oine makeigana wate ꞌiꞌewena ga manuna ꞌilokagutoki Yaubada ꞌena ga ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi, ta ꞌigwae, “Maiboꞌami wanunuma.
Gete lalagu, loina auwauna manuna, ꞌidaudau tomota yaumi ꞌimi toꞌumalinao ꞌadi ꞌebe nuwatau manuna.
Ta yaeonami tuta gete be mulinaya oine gete geyaꞌabo ꞌenega yanumanuma limana ga ꞌana laba ꞌomi maꞌegwao oine auwauna tanunuma Tamagu ꞌina senaya.”
ꞌEnega wali ꞌebweuna siwaliyena ga siapwesa ta situꞌe ꞌOya Olibe ꞌenaya.
Yesu ꞌisimana apwesa ꞌaene Pita ꞌida eyaseyaseye
Ta Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Batuwa boiboiya maiboꞌami wada denasinegu, nadigega Buki Tabu ꞌina simana, ꞌigwae, ‘Toꞌitaꞌiꞌita sipi yaloemwawasi be sipi maiboꞌadi sida ꞌelelewana.’
Ta ꞌigu toololimana mulinaya Galili ꞌena yatatauya be ꞌomi muliguyega wawawai.”
ꞌEnega Pita ꞌilolagata ga ꞌigwae, “ꞌIabe maiboꞌadi sidena sineyo ta tebweugu maꞌiyayo.”
Ta Yesu Pita ꞌieonena, “Yaona ꞌaiꞌaila boiboi batuwa, muliyega be kakaleko ꞌigwagwane ta ꞌoyo matoi ꞌueyaseyaseyegu.”
Ta Pita ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, geyaꞌabo saꞌi yaeyaseyaseyeyo! ꞌEguma siloemwawasiyo ꞌaboꞌagu wate maꞌiyayo siloemwawasida.” Tomuliyao maiboꞌadi wate nadigega sionaona.
Sena Gedesemani ꞌena Yesu ꞌisidasida Tamana ꞌena
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌina tononoyao maꞌenao sitauya ꞌebweu sena ꞌana esana Gedesemani ꞌena, ta ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Gete ꞌena wamiyami, ta ꞌaboꞌagu yaalaga be yasisida Yaubada ꞌena.”
Ta site toi ꞌiꞌauꞌewedi, Pita be Sebedi natunao ꞌeluwa. ꞌEnega Yesu ma ina ꞌateuyauya ta ma ina nuwamwau ꞌieonedi,
ꞌigwae, “ꞌAtegu ꞌiuyauya sinabwana, nai ꞌiabe yamwamwawasa, ꞌenega bada wamiyami ta walomataꞌiꞌita, be ꞌenega walemegu.”

Ta Yesu ꞌialaga tupwana ga baleꞌuya ꞌibeꞌu sanamwaꞌuta ta ꞌisidasida, ꞌigwae, “Tamagu ye, ꞌeguma kapekapeyana ꞌelouya keigana gete ꞌeguyega ꞌuꞌewayaulei, ta geyaꞌabo ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌigu nuwena ꞌenega, ta ꞌoyo esi ꞌimu nuwena ꞌenega ꞌuda guinuwa.”
ꞌEnega ꞌiila ga ꞌina tononoyao site toi nidi ꞌilobedi niꞌatu siꞌeno mwataya, ga Pita ꞌilowanowanona ga ꞌigwae, “Pita, nigeya sawesawemuya be ꞌumatapaꞌala be ꞌulemegu tuta gidalina namo manuna, aga?”
Ga wate ꞌieonedi maiboꞌadi, ꞌigwae, “ꞌIlobwenemi be wamatapaꞌala be wasidasida, be ꞌenega geyaꞌabo Seitani ꞌitootoomi. Onaꞌaiꞌaila yaluyaluwami nuwanuwana, ta tuga manuna oomi sitaba.”
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌilaga limana ga ꞌisidasida, ꞌigwae, “Tamagu, keiga gete geya nuwagu be ꞌenega yanunuma, ta ꞌabo ꞌimu nuwena nadigega, ta nigeya ꞌebweu wate ꞌeda ꞌimiyami, boboꞌana yanunuma tuga.”
Ta Yesu wate ꞌiila ꞌina tononoyao ꞌediya ga ꞌilobedi wate siꞌeno mwataya, manuna matadi niꞌatu siꞌenoꞌeno.
ꞌEnega wate ꞌipilisinedi ga ꞌina sidasida ꞌetonina ꞌenaya ꞌina sidasida ꞌeluwena nadigega.

Ta ꞌiila limanama ga ꞌina tononoyao ꞌilowanowanodi, ga ꞌigwae, “Mwaꞌadega, maꞌetamo waꞌenoꞌeno ta waeyaeyawaiꞌata, aga? Ta waꞌita ꞌaboꞌagu Tomota Natuna ꞌigu tuta niꞌatu ꞌiapwesa be sida sipupuyegu totoꞌumalidi ꞌediya.
Watoolo be tatatauya, manuna ꞌagu totelesipupu nina niꞌatu gete ꞌimeema.”
Yesu sigiyaina

Yesu ꞌetamo ꞌionaona ta ꞌebweu ꞌina tonono, Yudasa, tolosaiyao maꞌenao siapwesa. Totaliyao sinabwadi be me Isileli ꞌidi ꞌinapwanao tolosaiyao nidi sietunedi Yudasa maꞌedi, Yesu sabi giyaina, ta boda nidi ma idi sisisaiyao be wepasiyao wate simai.
Ta Yudasa weꞌiweꞌiyaya niꞌatu ꞌediya ꞌisimanena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌAbo yaita yaꞌatubwaili, nate tauna Yesu, be wagiyai.”
ꞌEnega ꞌitauya palupaluna Yesu ꞌena ga ꞌilokagutokiyena ta ꞌiꞌatubwailina.
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “Gosiyagu, toꞌase manuna ꞌumai?” ꞌEnega boda nidi siapwesama ga Yesu sigiyaina.
Ta Yesu ꞌina bodao ꞌebweuna ꞌediyega ꞌina sisisaiya ꞌilisilolona ga totaliya sinabwana ꞌina toguinuwa tenana ꞌiupwa yaulena.
Ta Yesu tai nina ꞌieonena, “Tuwa! ꞌImu sisisaiya ꞌusaꞌuile ꞌina senaya, manuna tolosaiyao taudi losaiya ꞌenega simwamwawasa.
ꞌUda mwalatoni ꞌaene ꞌabo nuwanuwagu Tamagu ꞌena yasisida ꞌagu lema manuna, ꞌiabe gete tuga aniloseyao mabodadi tomoyauyau ꞌietunedima.
Ta nigeya! ꞌEda gete ꞌenega Buki Tabu ꞌina simanao manugu sida apwesa.”

Gote ꞌena Yesu boda ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Sana ꞌaboꞌagu toꞌipwala, ga ꞌenega ma imi sisisaiya be ma imi wepasi wamai sabi giyaigu! Ta toꞌase ꞌalena ga ꞌenega nigeya wagiyagiyaigu ꞌasiyata nidi yaudi Anuwa Tabu ꞌena yamiyami ta yaeꞌieꞌita tomota ꞌediya?
Ta yage getedi sida apwesa be ꞌenega palopitao ꞌidi gimisimana Buki Tabu solanaya sida apwesa.” ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌina tononoyao maiboꞌadi sidena sinena.
Yesu ꞌina etala ꞌinapwanao matadiya
Boda nidi niꞌatu Yesu sigiyaina ga siꞌauꞌewena totaliyao ꞌidi ꞌinapwana, ꞌana esana Kaiyapa, ꞌenaya. Ta Kaiyapa ꞌina anuwaya loina ꞌana toeꞌitao be ꞌinapwanao niꞌatu sideli egogonama ga simiyami.
Ta Pita ꞌedasolega Yesu ꞌimuliyena ga ꞌimai totaliya sinabwana ꞌina ꞌasaya, ga ꞌilugu anuwaya ta toꞌitaꞌiꞌitao maꞌediya simiyatowa be ꞌaene Pita nina Yesu ꞌana loina ꞌida nono.
Ta totaliya sinabwadi be ꞌinapwanao nidi nuwanuwadi Yesu ꞌana toeꞌewa kabokabo sida loba be ꞌidi eꞌewa ꞌenega Yesu sida loemwawasi.
ꞌEnega toeꞌewa kabokabo yaudi simai, ta esi ꞌidi eꞌewa nigeya palupaludi. Ta muliyega ꞌeluwa tai simai
ga sigwae, “Yesu lowa ꞌiona, ꞌigwae, ‘Sawesaweguya be Yaubada ꞌina anuwa yalige yaulei, be ꞌasiyata ꞌetoi ꞌediya yada ꞌabilima.’”
ꞌEnega totaliyao ꞌidi ꞌinapwana sinabwana ꞌitoolo, ga ꞌigwae, “Nigeya ꞌimu eꞌisamo, aga? Tomota gotedi ꞌidi eꞌewa ꞌemuya niꞌatu ꞌunononaya?”
Ta Yesu tuga ꞌiꞌalaenono. ꞌEnega totaliya sinabwana Yesu ꞌieonena, “ꞌUona ꞌaiꞌaila Yaubada matanaya, mwaꞌadega ꞌoyo Toꞌetoseyana niyo, ta Yaubada natuna, nai nigeya?”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “Niꞌatu nate ꞌuona saba, ta wate yaeonami ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌagu Tomota Natuna be maꞌetamo waꞌitagu Toewaiwai sana ꞌatainaya yamiyami be wate galewa pwananao debadiyega yamama.”

ꞌEnega totaliya sinabwana nina ꞌigamwasowala ꞌaiꞌaila ga taunamo ꞌana ꞌoama ꞌisabuna ta ꞌigwae, “ꞌIna ona toꞌumalina wanononaya? Onaꞌaiꞌaila, tai gete Yaubada ꞌisinalina. Tuwa! Geyaꞌabo wate toeꞌewao sionaona ꞌina loegesiyao manudi.
Mwaꞌadega ꞌimi nuwanuwa Yesu manuna?” Ga taudi sigwae, “ꞌIlobwenena be ꞌimwamwawasa.”
ꞌEnega maninina sigiwalina ta siunu dadanena, ta wate ꞌaidi sisapina,
ta sigwae, “ꞌEguma ꞌoyo Toꞌetoseyana nina ꞌuona apwesa ꞌemaya ꞌaene yaita tauna ꞌisapimu? Manuna ꞌuona ꞌaene ꞌoyo palopita.”
Pita Yesu ꞌieyaseyaseyena
Ta Pita maꞌetamo ꞌetauluya ꞌimiyami ga toguinuwa gomagweine ꞌebweuna ꞌiapwesama ga ꞌienaidena, ꞌigwae, “Lowa goma Galili Yesu nina ꞌoyo maꞌiyayo wamiyami, aga?”
Ta tomota yaudi matadiya Pita ꞌieyaseyase, ꞌigwae, “Yage nina ꞌuonaonae nigeya yamwalamwalatoni.”
ꞌEnega Pita ꞌidena ga tupwana ꞌiaapwesa. Ta ꞌebweu wate gomagweine Pita ꞌiꞌitena ga tomiya nidi ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Tai gote lowa Yesu goma Nasaleta maꞌiyana.”
Wate Pita ꞌieyaseyase ta ꞌisawa tamatamana ga ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana ꞌimwalatonina ꞌaene tai nina ꞌaboꞌagu nigeya yamwalamwalatoni.”
Tuta kukupana namo mulinaya toyoꞌo nidi Pita ꞌenaya simai, ta sigwae, “Onaꞌaiꞌaila ꞌukabo! ꞌOyo Yesu ꞌina boda ꞌebweu, manuna ꞌimu lewa ꞌatuwa me Galili ꞌenadi.”
ꞌEnega Pita ꞌisawa tamatamana ta ona toꞌumalina ꞌenega ꞌibwautuꞌe, ꞌigwae, “Tamada! Tai nate nigeya yamwalamwalatoni.” Ta tuta gote ꞌena kakaleko ꞌigwane.
ꞌEnega Pita Yesu ꞌina ona ꞌinuwaꞌiꞌisina ꞌaene “Muliyega be kakaleko ꞌigwagwane ta ꞌoyo matoi ꞌueyaseyaseyegu.” ꞌEnega Pita nuwana ꞌimwau sinabwana ga ꞌiapwesa ꞌatamanaya ga ꞌidedoi.
